body.name: augmented target-family confidence region
body.construction: \(W_n=\{\zeta:mI_d\preceq Z_e\preceq MI_d,\ \lVert\zeta-\widehat\Sigma\rVert_w\le c_{\alpha}\}\), \(\widetilde\theta_n=s_1(\widehat\Sigma)\), \(R_n=W_n\cup\{\widetilde\theta_n\}\), \(\mathcal F_{\mathrm{out},n}=\bigcup_{\zeta\in R_n\cap\Theta_K}\mathcal F_{\mathrm{LDL}}(\zeta)\), and \(\mathcal H_n=\{h(\zeta):\zeta\in R_n\cap\Theta_K\}\).
